No plugins are installed. IMT works with its built-in importers and exporters.

A plugin extends IMT without changing the app. Backend plugins can add importers (read a new file format), transforms (a step you can use in the profile pipeline), exporters (write events to a new format) and hooks (react to events such as a finished import).
